svg.title: BasilCare AI - domain model of the API (api/src/main/java/.../entities)

g.text: BasilCare AI - domain model of the API (api/src/main/java/.../entities)
type : threshold | stale | offline | pump_fault | invalid_message | leaf_anomaly
At most one unresolved incident per key.
A cleared condition keeps the incident open
until a person resolves it with a note (FR-04).
Command pattern: each request is an object,
recorded BEFORE it is sent (also when rejected).
